definitions.explanation: An orchard where apples are grown commercially. Common throughout the apple-producing regions of Japan, especially Aomori, Nagano, and Iwate. Often appears in tourism contexts, since many orchards offer pick-your-own apple experiences (りんご{狩|が}り) in the autumn harvest season.

examples.japanese: りんご{園|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。

examples.english: When autumn comes, the apple orchards fill with bright red fruit.

examples.japanese: {青森|あおもり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧りんご{園|えん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{連|づ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦りんご{狩|が}り→りんご狩り：27924_ringogari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいた→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: At an apple orchard in Aomori, families were enjoying apple picking.

notes:
Compound of ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧ ('apple') and the suffix {園|えん} ('garden; orchard; plantation'), commonly attached to fruit names to denote orchards: also seen in ぶどう{園|えん} ('vineyard'), みかん{園|えん} ('mandarin orange grove'), {梨|なし}{園|えん} ('pear orchard'). The headword is usually written with ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧ in kana, though the kanji {林檎|りんご} also appears.

USAGE:
- Strongly associated with northern Japan, especially Aomori (Japan's leading apple producer) and Nagano.
- Many orchards are open to the public during the autumn harvest for ⟦りんご{狩|が}り→りんご狩り：27924_ringogari⟧ ('apple picking'), making the word common in tourism brochures and seasonal news.
- Other plantation suffixes are: {園|えん} (general, for fruit/flower farms), ⟦{農園|のうえん}→農園：26824_nouen⟧ (a working farm garden), ⟦{果樹園|かじゅえん}→果樹園：06472_kajuen⟧ (fruit orchard, more general).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- りんご{園|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run an apple orchard
- りんご{園|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit an apple orchard
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧りんご{園|えん}: a vast apple orchard
- りんご{園|えん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦りんご{狩|が}り→りんご狩り：27924_ringogari⟧: apple picking at an orchard
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧りんご{園|えん}: a family-run apple orchard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{果樹園|かじゅえん}→果樹園：06472_kajuen⟧: fruit orchard — general term for any orchard.
- ぶどう{園|えん}: vineyard — same suffix pattern but for grapes.
- ⟦{農園|のうえん}→農園：26824_nouen⟧: farm; plantation — broader term for a cultivated farm or garden, including fruit, vegetables, and flowers.
- {林檎農家|りんごのうか}: apple farmer / apple-growing household — refers to the people, not the place.
- ⟦りんご{狩|が}り→りんご狩り：27924_ringogari⟧: apple picking — the seasonal activity at a りんご{園|えん}.
